description: This Java class implements a service for managing CalculatedField entities within the Thingsboard platform, including saving, finding, and deleting calculated fields with validation and logging.

classes.name: DefaultTbCalculatedFieldService
classes.description: Service class for managing CalculatedField entities, including save, find, and delete operations with validation and logging.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a CalculatedField entity, performing validation, and logs the action.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a CalculatedField by its ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEntityId
methods.description: Finds calculated fields associated with a specific tenant and entity, with optional filtering by type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CalculatedField entity and logs the deletion.

methods.name: checkForEntityChange
methods.description: Validates that the entity ID of a calculated field has not changed after creation.

methods.name: checkEntity
methods.description: Validates that the entity type supports calculated fields and that the entity exists.
